Rhea (CS): Quick notes from Accelerant onboarding call. Customer asked for: 1) per-route cost caps to isolate expensive embedding jobs, 2) clearer retry/error traces in Console, 3) guidance for chunking long PDFs (they see recall drop), and 4) a simple pilot offer to test settings. They signaled concern about renewal if we don't show movement.

Omar - PM: thanks. Can we get one reproducible sample for the embeddings case and a count of similar tickets?

Jules (Support): attaching ticket INC-3412 and I'll run a query for similar incidents. Preliminary count: 6 in last 8 weeks labeled "embedding-low-recall".

Pri (Eng): for the recall issue, first pass is chunking + OCR noise. If you can drop the sample I can run a quick spike (3-5 days) and report back with interim recommendations.

Ben (PS): from field: per-route caps are a frequent ask for customers running nightly batches. Low-to-medium effort to expose config, medium if we need billing instrumentation. Happy to propose a pilot and cover commercial framing.

Rhea (CS): csbot logged signal: "CS-6688 - Accelerant - feature_request" link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-6688

csbot: New customer signal recorded: CS-6688 (Accelerant). Priority: candidate.

Omar - PM: proposed prioritization: 1) per-route caps (pilot), 2) retry/trace visibility, 3) embeddings repro + guidance, 4) publish 1-pager.

Jules (Support): will tag related tickets with severity (revenue-risk vs ux-annoyance) and attach samples to CS-6688.

Pri (Eng): I'll own the reproduce spike. If chunking, interim recommendation: 1k-2k token chunks with 15% overlap and simple header/footer stripping.

Ben (PS): I'll draft a short pilot offer for Accelerant to cover engineering time and get them started.

Rhea (CS): I'll send Accelerant a short note: "we're opening a pilot and will share a quick guidance doc this week; engineering will run a spike and we'll follow up with timelines." Scheduling a 20-min groom for tomorrow 9:30am PT.

Omar - PM: thanks team, please post attachments and spike results in CS-6688.

csbot: Label update: CS-6688 tagged [candidate, revenue-risk].
